messages:
Alyssa: Quick sync — product received several asks about the conversation API shape. some customers insist on 'prompt' compatibility, others want richer per-message roles. thoughts?
Mike: my take: keep messages as the canonical shape, but provide a compatibility shim for prompt. minimal surface area.
Song: Customer-ACME needs to attach a system-level instruction per turn (they're orchestrating assistant personas). can we support per-message system tags?
Kevin: technically we can add a message-level "role" enum (system/user/assistant) + optional "meta". security concern: per-message system increases prompt-injection risk if uncontrolled.
Alyssa: proposal: default model accepts messages [system,user,assistant]; per-message system allowed only when org-level feature flag enabled and with logging/audit. otherwise enforce single initial system message.
Sara: agree on gating. also call-out tool/function flow — functions should keep the same call contract; we add a "caller" field mapping to message author so downstream apps can attribute calls.
Mike: implementation note: changing message shape impacts caching/prefix keys. prefer additive fields only so we don't invalidate existing cache keys.
Alyssa: example minimal compat helper in SDKs: 
```
// convert old prompt string -> messages[]
function promptToMessages(promptStr, systemPrompt) {
  return [{ role: 'system', content: systemPrompt }, { role: 'user', content: promptStr }];
}
```
Sara: +1 for SDK shim. also need evals: verify semantic parity across prompt->messages for top-5 customer prompts. add to Optimize backlog.
Song: security checklist: ensure per-message system is sanitized, KMS-backed audit log for system messages, and clear admin-only toggle.
Kevin: launch criteria draft: 1) API schema docs + SDK helpers, 2) migration guide, 3) security gating implemented, 4) perf/regression <=5% on p95 latency for typical workloads, 5) 3 internal apps on Dedicated for validation.
Alyssa: timeline suggestion: beta in 6 weeks, wide in 12. prioritize Customer-ACME and Customer-B for per-message system and compact-prompt import.
Mike: backlog items: API schema PR, SDK shim, docs, eval tests, canary rollout plan. I'll own API PR.
Song: I'll own security gate and audits.
Sara: I'll draft migration guide and user-facing docs.
devops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: infra-canary-2 -> prod-canary at 2025-05-02 10:00 UTC.
Alyssa: small UX question — for unknown roles in messages, do we coerce to "user" or fail? my vote: coerce to user and warn in logs.
Kevin: coerce + hard error only when org flag set to strict.
Mike: also add opt-in query param `compat=prompt` so customers can send legacy param until they migrate.
Alyssa: ok. I'll open the PR with schema draft and include example shapes + conversion helper. ping here when up.
Kevin: pinged. thanks all. :thumbsup:
